message: Hey neighbors! 🔥 I just came across a handy resource about home fires that really emphasizes how we can turn what seems like a daunting topic into something manageable and even cozy. It’s all about prevention and preparation — think of it as a gentle nudge to create a warm, safe space at home! After all, a little planning can help keep our family gatherings full of warmth and laughter, without any worries. What’s one small change you’ve made to keep your home cozy and safe?
